name: SVC_MCA_NAV_ACTION
description:
This table is used to store the navigation action related to the SVC MCA setup.

Provides detail about which screen needs to be popped and with what parameters.

columns.name: NAVIGATION_ACTION_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: A unique identifier for a user friendly name of the lookup set.

columns.name: DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: A user friendly display name for this navigation action

columns.name: METHOD_NAME
columns.description: Deprecated - The method for the navigation action

columns.name: PATH
columns.description: The path used for the navigation action

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: A detailed description of the lookup set.

columns.name: VIEW_ID
columns.description: The view id used for the navigation path

columns.name: WEBAPP_NAME
columns.description: Name of the web application for this navigation action

columns.name: LABEL
columns.description: Label used for the navigation action

columns.name: TASK_KEY_LIST
columns.description: Deprecated - Key list to pass into the task flow to open in the target workspace. This is a semicolon delimited keys or key-value pairs. For example, "key1;key2=value2"

columns.name: TASK_PARAM_LIST
columns.description: Deprecated - Parameters list to pass in to the task flow to open in the target workspace

columns.name: PAGE_PARAM_LIST
columns.description: Deprecated - Parameters list for the page. This is a semicolon delimited String of name value pairs. For example, "param1=value1;param2=value2"

columns.name: TITLE_PREFIX
columns.description: The beginning portion of the title displayed on the navigation page.

columns.name: TITLE_TOKEN_ID
columns.description: The value of the token to display as part of the title.

columns.name: TITLE_SUFFIX
columns.description: The suffix of the title displayed for the navigated page.

columns.name: ENTITY_ID
columns.description: This is used to identify the view object used to derive the parameters for Map parameters associated to the page.

columns.name: EDITABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if this is a seeded record.

columns.name: UI_TYPE_CD
columns.description: The user interface type mapping to the lookup type 'ORA_SVC_MCA_SCREEN_PAGE_TYPE'.

columns.name: PAGE_TYPE_CD
columns.description: The page type mapping to the lookup type 'ORA_SVC_MCA_PAGE_TYPE'.

columns.name: PAGE_KEY
columns.description: This is specified to uniquely identify a page and is used by page developers.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the category is logically deleted (Y or N).

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
